movie_title: Can jellyfish help us solve our problems? 6 Minute English
introduction:
Improve your English vocabulary and listening in just six minutes!
Scientific research is discoverin

vocabulary.definition: long, slender, flexible arms or appendages of an animal, especially of an octopus, jellyfish, or squid
vocabulary.example: The octopus used its tentacles to catch its prey.

vocabulary.definition: blocking or congesting a passage with an accumulation of thick, wet matter
vocabulary.example: The drain was clogged with hair and dirt.

vocabulary.definition: a slimy substance, typically produced by the body in response to irritation or infection
vocabulary.example: When you have a cold, your body produces more mucus.

vocabulary.definition: having the ability to soak up or take in a substance
vocabulary.example: Sponges are highly absorptive and can hold a lot of water.

vocabulary.definition: animals that actively hunt and kill other animals for food
vocabulary.example: Lions are fierce predators in the wild.

vocabulary.definition: pollution caused by very small particles, typically those less than 5 mm in size
vocabulary.example: Microplastics contribute to micropollution in the oceans.
